transcript_turns.content: The board has asked where next year's incremental headcount, 40 open roles across the portfolio, should go to maximize combined revenue growth without increasing the combined loss ratio in lending. Business banking grew 31.9% but remains the smallest line at $28M ARR; payments grew 24.6%; lending grew 6.1%.
Put all 40 roles into business banking. It's growing the fastest, so that's where the growth is.
